gone.text: A smashed bus shelter and a trail of glass. Whoever did it is gone. Two kids on bikes say he was "glowing."

boost.text: A man on Spark is tearing a parking meter out of the concrete with his bare hands. His eyes are wrong.

options.text: Keep your distance and wait for him to burn out.

success.note: He pulls the probes out and turns toward you.

boost_wait.text: Ten minutes. Twelve. He sits down hard on the curb, shaking, bleeding from the nose.

options.text: Cuff him and call the RA.

success.note: In custody and on his way to County.

options.text: Call the RA and stay back.
